author: fable-cursor
criterion: Purple blooms sit in the left foreground of shot D similar to the reference.
note: Purple blooms sit in the left foreground of D where the reference has them, among ferns and moss on the bank, and they read as purple after fog (D purpleFraction 0.0049 against the 0.003 threshold; 287 flower clusters). Nits, not a fail against this criterion: ours are five-petal stars roughly 20 cm across scattered in two broad bands across the whole bank and up the right verge as well, where the reference has one compact clump of 5-15 cm blooms beside a lit boulder; the saturation is well above the reference's hazed #4f3558, which ANALYSIS.md section 13 records as a deliberate consequence of the rubric's own purple threshold being stricter than the reference frame.
